newsitem.title: UK: Barclays down as buyback nearly complete.
newsitem.headline: Barclays down as buyback nearly complete.

text.p: Shares in Barclays Plc defied the UK market's sharp rise on Thursday as the bank was seen to have virtually completed its share buyback, removing a support for the stock, dealers said.
"Maybe the big buyer is out of the market for the time being, all of a sudden the party is over," said one market-maker in the stock.
Barclays shares were down 7p at 11.01-1/2 stg by 1000 GMT, even as the FTSE 100 was up 32.8 points at 4,392.9, after earlier setting a record 4,393.2.

Barclays on Wednesday said it had bought a further 10.4 million shares. It had previously bought 10.7 million under a programme to repurchase a total of some 26 million shares or 1.7 percent of its share capital.

The market's initial lukewarm response to the buyback had been seen as underpinning the stock, since Barclays was actively continuing its repurchase programme and institutions seemed to be reluctant to sell.
"Maybe people are taking the view that institutions have now been willing to release stock," said another trader.
